updates.checksLabel: Setting that lets the app look for a newer version on GitHub.
updates.autoLabel: Setting that downloads and installs new versions without asking each time.
updates.available: Status bar text. {{version}} is a version number.
updates.update: Button that downloads and installs the new version. Gostman is the product name.
updates.downloading: Status bar text. {{version}} is a version number, {{percent}} a formatted percentage such as 42%.
updates.downloadingDetail: {{received}} and {{total}} are sizes such as 12 MB.
updates.ready: Status bar button that restarts the app to finish the update.
updates.failedHint: Preferences, Updates are names of the settings page and section.
updates.manual.scoop: {{command}} is a terminal command, kept as written.
updates.manual.homebrew: {{command}} is a terminal command, kept as written.
